title: AAPS turns off Bluetooth
symptom: Bluetooth turns off randomly, increasing in frequency over time until it cannot be turned on until AAPS is uninstalled and reinstalled. BYODA also stops working when this happens. The issue started about 6 weeks before reporting.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive cause. The user suspects AAPS, but maintainers suggest it may be phone-related or due to battery saving options. The user eventually resolved by switching to a new phone, implying the old phone had a Bluetooth problem.
fix: The user resolved the issue by switching to a new phone (S23), which worked fine. No specific AAPS setting fix was found.
evidence_quote: Now it's working fine on a S23. It seems that the old S21 phone had a BT problem.
